title: About Us
intro: At Resumelio, we believe everyone deserves a professional and attractive CV — regardless of their background or budget.
mission: That’s why we created a free and easy-to-use platform that helps you build your CV in minutes, not hours.
support: Whether you're applying for your first job or switching careers, our mission is to simplify the resume-building process and give you full control over the layout, language, and content.
features: A clean and intuitive interface for creating professional resumes
Customizable templates for different fields and styles
Support for multiple languages: Romanian, English, French, and German
One-click PDF download and secure data storage
100% free to use, with no hidden costs
closing: Resumelio was built by developers who know how hard it is to stand out — and we’re here to make that journey easier.
